s: Which Article of the Constitution has provision for removal of a member of Public Service Commission?
x: According to Article 317 of the Constitution, the Chairman or any other member of a Public Service Commission shall only be removed from his office by order of the President on the ground of misbehaviour after the Supreme Court, on reference being made to it by the President, has, an inquiry held in accordance with the procedure prescribed in that behalf under Article 145, reported that the Chairman or such other member, as the case may be, ought on any such ground to be removed.

s: The Chairman of Union Public Service Commission can be removed from his post by :
x: Under the Article 317 of the Constitution, the clause (1) provides that, the Chairman or any other member of a public service commission shall be removed from his office by order of the President on the ground of misbehaviour, only when the Supreme Court, on reference being made to it by the President, inquires in accordance with the procedure determined in that behalf under Article 145 and reports that the chairman or such other member, as the case may be, ought to be removed on any such grounds. According to the Article 317 clause (3), another way of removal is prescribed on some other grounds as, the President may by orders remove the chairman or any other member of a public service commission, if the chairman or member is adjudged an insolventi; or engages during his term of office in any outside, paid employment; or is unfit to continue in office due to infirmity of mind or body, in the opinion of the President.

Parliament must pass an impeachment resolution by special majority
